title: Update S7 arrow construction and package hooks
description:
`element_arrow()` fails with development S7 because its constructor still names the parent argument `.parent`. Pass the existing `element_line()` parent positionally to support both the released and development S7 APIs.

Use the available S7 load, build, and unload hooks, retaining `methods_register()` with older S7. Unloading removes this package's dependency hooks and owned methods on external S7 generics. The existing S7 version requirement is preserved. Method registration follows the existing deferred load work.

title: :rotating_light: Linting
description: Bunch of lints found through lintr

title: Implement distortions
description:
This PR aims to fix #6.

There is a new `distort` argument that can be used to apply some pattern to a line.

``` r
devtools::load_all("~/packages/ggarrow/")
#> ℹ Loading ggarrow
#> Loading required package: ggplot2

ggplot(whirlpool(), aes(x, y, colour = group)) +
  geom_arrow(distort = "sinewave") +
  coord_equal()
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/2G8RV8B.png)<!-- -->

<sup>Created on 2025-10-11 with [reprex v2.1.1](https://reprex.tidyverse.org)</sup>

title: Arrow separator
description:
This PR aims to fix #8.

It adds a `sep` argument that allows one to dodge co-localised arrows.

``` r
devtools::load_all("~/packages/ggarrow/")
#> ℹ Loading ggarrow
#> Loading required package: ggplot2

df <- data.frame(
  x = c(0, 1, 1, 0),
  y = c(0, 1, 1, 0),
  g = c("a", "a", "b", "b")
)

ggplot(df, aes(x, y, colour = g, linewidth = g)) +
  geom_arrow(
    sep = 5, 
    arrow_head = arrow_head_halfwing(direction = -1),
    length_head = 5
  )
#> Warning: Using linewidth for a discrete variable is not advised.
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/lb0ctjr.png)<!-- -->
